title: Exact functor and coefficient map on an individual Ext cocycle
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with Ext groups [def-pc-ext], L:C→D an additive exact functor, A,B objects of C, A′,B′ objects of D, α:A′→L(A), and v:L(B)→B′. Let R,R′ be injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of B,B′. Let φ:L(R)→R′ be a chain map whose composite with L of the augmentation is homotopic to the single-complex comparison followed by v and the target augmentation. For q≥0 and a:A→R^q with a;d_R=0, suppose a′=α;L(a);φ^q satisfies a′;d_R′=0. The Ext class of a′ in R′ equals the composite of Ext.mk₀(α), L applied to the Ext class of a in R, and Ext.mk₀(v). This is a formula on individual cocycles before quotient descent, homology, or sections evaluation.

proof.text: Use Mathlib extEquivCohomologyClass_symm_mk_hom and Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom to express both sides as derived-category roofs. ShiftedHom.comp_map and map_naturality_2 transport the mapped numerator through mapDerivedCategoryFactors; the single-complex comparison identifies its source.

Apply DerivedCategory.Q_map_eq_of_homotopy to the given augmentation homotopy. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv and cancellation of the invertible mapped augmentation give factors.inv(R);mapDerivedCategory(inv(Q(ι_R)));singleComparison.hom(B);Q(single(v)) = Q(φ);inv(Q(ι_R′)). This is a direct equality of localized morphisms, requiring no bijectivity theorem for maps into K-injectives. The coefficient morphism remains after the single-complex comparison and is carried through the same denominator cancellation.

Check the numerator at degree zero by HomologicalComplex.from_single_hom_ext. The component formulas for Cocycle.equivHomShift.symm, fromSingleMk, and mapHomologicalComplex show it is exactly α;L(a);φ^q. Transport this equality with ShiftedHom.map and combine it with the denominator equality. Ext.hom injectivity closes the claim. All formulas also hold for q=0 and zero α or a.

proof_origin.note: Complete derived-category roof calculation extending the proved pure-pullback cocycle argument to a coefficient map.

lean.statement:
theorem ext_mapExactFunctor_coefficient_cocycle
    {C : Type w} {D : Type w'} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasExt.{v} C] [HasExt.{v} D]
    (L : C ⥤ D) [L.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L]
    {A B : C} {A' B' : D} (α : A' ⟶ L.obj A)
    (R : InjectiveResolution B) (R' : InjectiveResolution B') (v : L.obj B ⟶ B')
    (φ : (L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj R.cochainComplex ⟶ R'.cochainComplex)
    (hφ : Nonempty (Homotopy
      ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map R.ι' ≫ φ)
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex L (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app B ≫
        (singleFunctor D 0).map v ≫ R'.ι')))
    (q : ℕ) (a : A ⟶ R.cochainComplex.X (q : ℤ))
    (ha : a ≫ R.cochainComplex.d (q : ℤ) ((q : ℤ) + 1) = 0)
    (ha' : (α ≫ L.map a ≫ φ.f (q : ℤ)) ≫
      R'.cochainComplex.d (q : ℤ) ((q : ℤ) + 1) = 0) :
    ((Ext.mk₀ α).comp
      ((R.extEquivCohomologyClass.symm
        (.mk (Cocycle.fromSingleMk a (zero_add (q : ℤ)) _ rfl ha))).mapExactFunctor L)
      (zero_add q)).comp (Ext.mk₀ v) (add_zero q) =
    R'.extEquivCohomologyClass.symm
      (.mk (Cocycle.fromSingleMk (α ≫ L.map a ≫ φ.f (q : ℤ))
        (zero_add (q : ℤ)) _ rfl ha'))
